EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Leap years are famous for having an
extra day.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} But do you know why
there's an extra day?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}We divide a year into an even 365
days, but a year is actually more
like 365.25 days long.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}So those leftover quarter days
build until we have one full extra
day every fourth year!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}It's like we're saving up bonus 
points to buy an extra day! Kinda
cool, huh? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Los años bisiestos son esos que
tienen un día de más. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Tú sabes
por qué es?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Dicen que al parecer dividimos los
años en 365 días, pero en realidad
duran 365,25{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ¡Qué flipe!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Claro, si sumas ese tiempo de más,
¡acabas acumulando un día entero!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Es como ir juntando puntos para
conseguir una vida extra, ¿no? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Tout l'monde sait qu'une année
bissextile compte un jour de plus.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Mais t'en connais la raison ?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}On divise une année en 365 jours,
mais en fait, le nombre correct est
plus proche de 365,25.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Du coup, les quarts de jour restants
s'accumulent jusqu'à former un jour
supplémentaire tous les quatre ans !
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Un peu comme si t'économisais des
points bonus pour t'offrir un jour
de plus ! Cool, hein,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Gli anni bisestili, si sa, hanno
un giorno in più.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Ma tu lo sai
perché?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Per noi un anno è composto da 365
giorni, ma in realtà è come se fosse
lungo 365,25 giorni.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Perciò ogni anno avanza un quarto
di giorno che, sommato a quelli
dei tre successivi, fa un giorno!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}È come se mettessimo da parte
dei punti bonus per comprare
un giorno in più! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Schaltjahre haben einen Tag mehr.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}
Weißte, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wieso das so ist?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Die Erde braucht etwas länger
als 365 Tage, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}um die Sonne zu
umkreisen.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Also nehmen wir alle vier Jahre

halbwegs wieder aufgeht!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Mich erinnert das immer ein bissel
an Bonuspunkte, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}die man irgend-
wann einlösen kann{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Artık yıllar fazladan bir günleriyle
meşhur.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Peki o günün neden eklendiğini
biliyor musun? {{TAG:0003:000B:}} Bir yılı 365 gün diye
hesaplıyoruz ama aslında yaklaşık
365,25 gün sürüyor. {{TAG:0003:0015:}} O artan çeyrek
günler birikip dört yılda tam bir güne

ekstra gün satın alıyoruz! Havalı, ha? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
